answer.reason: Jeremiah 43 tells two things that happened at Tahpanhes: the arrival of the Judah remnant and the LORD's command to Jeremiah to hide stones there.

clauses.english: was where the people of Judah came in disobedience to the LORD
clauses.quote: thus came they even to Tahpanhes

clauses.english: was where the LORD told Jeremiah to hide great stones in the brickkiln as a sign of Nebuchadrezzar's coming
clauses.quote: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln

doubts: JER 2:16, JER 44:1, JER 46:14 and EZK 30:18 only list the city or foretell its fate, so they were not used as clauses.
